title: Efficacy of MIrikizumab to achieve traNsmural healing in patiENTs with Crohn’s Disease : EMINENT CD
official: Efficacy of MIrikizumab to achieve traNsmural healing in patiENTs with Crohn’s Disease : EMINENT CD
summary: Main objective: To describe the efficacy of mirikizumab therapy to achieve transmural response in patients with CD.

interventions.name: Omvoh 100 mg solution for injection in pre-filled pen
Omvoh 300 mg concentrate for solution for infusion
Omvoh 200 mg solution for injection in pre-filled syringe
Omvoh 100 mg + 200 mg solution for injection in pre-filled pen

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients with CD
2. ≥ 18 years-old ≤ 75 years old
3. Symptomatic CD according to PRO-2 (stool > 3 or abdominal pain score > 1)
4. Transmural inflammation on baseline MRI (C-score > 0.5 in at least one segment)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Prior exposure to anti-p19 biological therapy
2. No health insurance
3. Pregnant or lactating women
4. Patients already included in biomedical research other than an observational study (e.g., registry, cohort)
5. Concomitant Clostridioides difficile infection
6. HIV infection
7. Patient under guardianship, curatorship or safeguard of justice
8. Exposure to more than 1 class of advanced therapies at a dose approved for the treatment of Crohn's disease (janus kinase [JAK] inhibitors, infliximab, adalimumab, certolizumab pegol, vedolizumab, ustekinumab, or approved biosimilars for these agents
9. Contra-indication to mirikizumab
10. Definitive ostomy
11. Colectomy with IPAA
12. Isolated or uncontrolled perianal lesions
13. Severe obstructive symptoms
14. Intra-abdominal abscess
15. Contra-indication to MRI
